stemMd: What is the distance from $(-2,4)$ to $(4,-4)$?
explanationMd: The coordinate differences are 6 and -8. Distance is $\sqrt{6^2+(-8)^2}=10$. Squaring removes the direction signs.

distractorRationale.c: Adds absolute coordinate changes instead of using Euclidean distance.
